name: Yamaha Road Star 1600 / 1700
engine: 1602 or 1670 cc air-cooled pushrod V-twin, carb (later fuel injected), belt drive
intro: Yamaha's big air-cooled cruiser. Early 1600s had a transmission recall. Carbs and fuel delivery are common complaints.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 1999-2001 XV1600s were in recall 06V397 for the transmission.
A-002.reason: Transmission recalls are free to fix.

G: Early bikes have a carb and later 1700s are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.

recalls.what: Transmission recall on certain Road Star models.
